session_check: Not settled, and it matters. The baseline says amc from the TradingView flag. positioning_check: ASIC aggregate short 1.2836% (8.24m shares) as of 2026-09-23, up from 0.7697% on 09-16, so +0.51pp building, with a 4-session lag. USL was halted from 22 Sept 09:29 until 24 Sept, so the whole build was put on over 16 to 21 Sept, ahead of a placement priced at a 10.1% discount. That was either pre-deal hedging or shorting into the 18 Sept +13% spike on 15.8m shares. Either way those shorts are about 16% in profit at 0.705, and any that are placement hedges will be closed by delivering the 1 Oct allotment, not by buying on market. At 1.28% it is not a crowded short and gives no squeeze fuel. The lean's squeeze and run-up terms (+0.77, +1.02) read the post-raise drop as mean-reversion fuel, but about half of the -16.6% 5-day move is the 10.1% placement discount and the rest tracks silver (SI=F 65.93 on 09-22 to 61.31 on 09-29, -7.0%).

September 2026 quarterly Activities and Cashflow Report (5B). Prior ones landed 22 Jul, 24 Apr, 19 Jan and 30 Oct 2025. It will show the start of the 20,000 m program and cash of about A$110m pro forma.

searched_and_found_nothing: Annual report content: for a pre-revenue explorer the FY26 accounts restate the 30 June balance sheet already in the June 2026 5B (22/07/2026). The 24 Sept raise re-stated pro-forma cash at A$110m, so there is no going-concern or runway surprise available to it. The 2025 annual report day moved +0.70% and the next day -3.50%, with no pattern.

Placement allotment on 1 Oct (78.9m shares, ~12% of pre-deal capital, ~30 sessions of median volume) at A$0.76 against spot A$0.705, so placees are 7% underwater. I considered placement dumping and dropped it. The timetable has been public since 24 Sept (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260924/pdf/074gf9tsgvttll.pdf, also reported at https://mining.com.au/unico-raises-60-million-for-argentina-projects/). Underwater long-only placees have little reason to flip. Hedged placees close by delivery. USL's own past allotment days point both ways: 27/08/2025 -1.27% and 24/11/2025 +8.08% (Yahoo tape). No sign I could defend.

Placement pricing and use of funds: fully funded to FID, DFS long-lead items, and a contingent Pan American payment on the maiden feasibility study. I found no distress reading, but all of it has been public since 24 Sept.
Cerro La Mata option (24 Sept, US$1.1m over 4 years plus a 1% NSR): immaterial and already public (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260924/pdf/074ghxxrljr8zn.pdf).

Santa Cruz provincial and Argentine news: only a routine technical meeting from 19 May 2026 (noticias.santacruz.gob.ar) and the Pampa Prospector week-39 roundup restating the raise (https://pampaprospector.substack.com/p/pampa-prospector-newsletter-392026). No permitting, RIGI or political item is dated inside the window.

Director and substantial holder flow: the last 3Y was 12/08/2026 (a final notice on the NED resignation) and the last substantial holder change was MHM on 03/09/2026. Nothing is clustered around the raise.
Pending drill results: 'summer drill season underway', but the last assay release was 22/06/2026 and nothing is scheduled or dated for 30 Sept to 1 Oct.
The Bull's 'technical breakdown' article (thebull.com.au) returned an empty body to both curl and WebFetch.
baseline_tension: Nothing I found gives a direction. The lean (+0.76) reads the -16.6% five-day drop and the short build as rebound fuel, but the drop is explained by a public 10.1%-discount placement plus a 7% fall in silver, and the build most likely closes by delivery on 1 Oct, not on market. I neither agree nor disagree with the lean and I add nothing to it.
